### CHECK 约束

- <code>admin_users_revoked_requires_disabled</code>


- <code>admin_users_revoked_requires_reason</code>

```sql
"revoked_at" IS NULL OR ("status_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("status_reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 255)
```

```sql
(("status_changed_at" IS NULL AND "status_changed_by" IS NULL AND "status_reason" IS NULL) OR ("status_changed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "status_changed_by" IS NOT NULL))
```
